It is not the persistent U10 compiler implementation, not Hostinger/Andreas target evidence, and not universal DB superiority.

supported: For U10 max_depth=3, reverse <=2 reachability is a complete structural no-false-negative invalidation frontier for edge additions/removals on this exact benchmark topology.

not_supported: The persistent SQLite-backed U10 compiler achieves the same end-to-end speedup.
Real ClayGraph/Frank mutation distributions have the same invalidation density.

Universal superiority over conventional databases or graph engines.

strongest_counterhypothesis: Persistent witness writes, generation publication, cache behavior, high-degree real topology, semantic edge-type restrictions and memory amplification may reduce or reverse the equivalent-mechanism speedup.
